about: The optimisation pipeline's lever definitions. The engine (ledger/levers.js) prices each one from the October ledger. Within a use case the levers are applied in the order given, each on the cost that remains after the ones before it, so savings never add up independently. Evidence grades: measured (arithmetic on measured quantities), assumption-based (price-sheet arithmetic on an assumed share or rate, assumption shown), Foundation prior (the low end of a FinOps Foundation range, used until a test measures it). Statuses: identified, validated, realised, blocked, on hold. Validated and realised need measured evidence; the engine keeps any other lever at identified.

levers.name: Route simple hard-case tickets from GPT-5.4 to GPT-5.4 mini

eligible.text: 40% of hard-case tickets are simple enough for the mini model by the triage rule (assumption; confirm on a labelled sample)

effect.text: low end of the Foundation range for right-sizing and routing

levers.qualityGate: Acceptance on routed tickets within 2 points of GPT-5.4 in a 200-ticket shadow test
levers.caution: Routing starts a new prompt cache on the mini deployment, so the caching lever is priced after it.

levers.name: Put the stable 4,000-token prefix first so automatic caching hits

eligible.text: all input tokens; current hit rate and prompt size measured from the gateway's token counts

effect.text: cached input bills at 10% of the input price with no write charge; the achievable hit rate is the stable prefix's share of the prompt, assuming every call reuses it within the cache lifetime

levers.qualityGate: No change to draft content: the prompt is reordered, not rewritten

levers.name: Cap reply length and ask for structured drafts

effect.text: low end of the Foundation range for output length control

levers.qualityGate: Agent acceptance rate does not fall

levers.name: Send the overnight explanation backlog through the Batch API

eligible.text: 40% of explanations are for the overnight re-scoring backlog and can wait up to 24 hours (assumption from the team's process; confirm from gateway timestamps)

effect.text: Batch is 50% off input and output on Azure Global Standard

levers.qualityGate: Backlog explanations ready before the morning review

levers.name: Batch the overnight KYC document runs

effect.text: Anthropic's batch platforms list does not include Microsoft Foundry

waysRound: Run the overnight backlog through a platform that lists batch for Claude (the Claude API), after a procurement and data-residency review
Stay on Foundry and cache the shared review instructions instead
levers.qualityGate: Not applicable until a platform route is agreed

levers.name: Pre-check documents and cap retries on long PDFs

eligible.text: cost of failed runs above the August to September failure rate

effect.text: a page-count pre-check and a two-retry cap remove 80% of the excess failures (assumption)

levers.qualityGate: Approval rate on documents that pass the pre-check does not fall

levers.name: Trim retrieved context to the top passages

effect.text: low end of the Foundation range for context management

levers.qualityGate: Share of answers rated useful does not fall

levers.name: Right-size the shared AI Search tier

eligible.text: the fixed S2 tier (six search units) that both retrieval users share

effect.text: no AI Search price in this pack's research: measure query load and index size, then price the smaller tier from the Azure Retail Prices API

levers.qualityGate: Retrieval latency and answer quality hold for both users of the index

levers.name: Scale non-production AKS to zero at night and at weekends

eligible.text: the non-production cluster's daily cost before the schedule

effect.text: daily cost after the schedule, from the bill

levers.qualityGate: Test environments up by 07:00 on working days

levers.name: Rightsize VMs that stayed under the CPU threshold all quarter

eligible.text: October cost of VMs whose monthly P95 CPU stayed under 20% (illustrative telemetry and threshold)

effect.text: one size down in the same series (D16s v5 to D8s v5, D8s v5 to D4s v5) halves the hourly rate in this illustrative rate card; confirm both rates from the Azure Retail Prices API before counting it

levers.qualityGate: P95 CPU on the new size stays under the owner's limit for two weeks

levers.name: Lifecycle tiering for logs and cost exports

eligible.text: hot-tier storage of logs and exports older than 30 days

effect.text: no storage price in this pack's research: to be priced from the Azure Retail Prices API
